title_en: Which Subway Seat Do Koreans Never Take? 🚇 #shorts
description_en: The end seats are for seniors, the disabled and pregnant women — and when they're empty, nobody sits. No fine, just nunchi. Learn 노약자석, 임산부 배려석 and 눈치 (reading the room). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
